The Appellate Authority has partly allowed the appeal and substantially reduced the demand raised in the Order-in-Original. Against the original demand of tax amounting to ₹45,48,181 (IGST: ₹34,37,501, CGST: ₹5,55,340 and SGST: ₹5,55,340), interest of ₹35,70,758 and penalty of ₹7,98,568, the Appellate Authority has sustained only tax of ₹12,578 (CGST: ₹6,289 and SGST: ₹6,289), interest of ₹12,578 (CGST: ₹6,289 and SGST: ₹6,289) and penalty of ₹20,000 (CGST: ₹10,000 and SGST: ₹10,000). The appeal was disposed of vide Appeal No. AD0905250352734 and Order No. ZD090826198715J dated 14.08.2026 and the company has paid the demand.

Over 1/5 of the order book is from emerging segments like data centers and semiconductors.

Appellate authority upheld ₹0.10 Cr transitional ITC demand and penalty for FY 2017-18.

timeline.summary: Schneider Electric Infrastructure announced the merger of its RTA, CB Management Services Private Limited, into MUFG Intime India Private Limited effective May 8, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹589.69 Cr (+0.5% YoY), net profit ₹21.97 Cr (-59.8% YoY).
Schneider Electric Infrastructure Limited shared the recording link for its May 29, 2026, conference call on Q4 FY2026 results under ‘Rec’ tab in ‘Q4’ section of its financial reports.
Schneider Electric Infrastructure held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 29, 2026, highlighting a 50% increase in order backlog.

Schneider Electric Infrastructure issued a postal ballot notice dated May 28, 2026, seeking shareholder approval for material related-party transactions up to ₹605 Cr with Schneider Electric IT Business India Private Limited.
Schneider Electric Infrastructure received a GST rectification order for FY20 reducing the penalty to ₹0.09 Cr alongside an unchanged tax demand of ₹0.93 Cr.

Schneider Electric Infrastructure held an earnings call on August 17, 2026, to discuss Q1FY27 results, highlighting a record order intake of ₹915 Cr and a 33% YoY growth in backlog to ₹2,100 Cr, while noting margin pressure from legacy orders and commodity inflation.
On October 18, 2026, Schneider Electric Infrastructure disclosed that the appellate authority upheld a ₹0.10 Cr transitional ITC demand and penalty for FY 2017-18.

Shareholder approval for Related Party Transactions via Postal Ballot

watchlist.response: Management explained that delivery deferrals were requested by customers due to project dependencies, and commodity headwinds impacted gross margins temporarily.
watchlist.text: Revenue growth was flat in Q4 and gross margins dropped due to commodity impacts.

watchlist.response: Price hike actions were initiated on time; margin fall is more due to operating leverage and RMI impact, which is expected to iron out.
watchlist.text: Impact of sticky commodity inflation on margins and why price hikes were not taken earlier compared to competitors.

watchlist.response: Difficult to quantify a specific number; the company is selective and strategic in engaging with contracts based on project visibility and execution ease, focusing on equipment supply and grid modernization.
